document_dispositions.rationale: Together with the twelve previously accepted facts, the final full-document remainder adds six distinct facts on FY2026 capacity investment and explicit information-quality limitations. All other objective-local content is either already accepted or semantically covered by the 141-fact prior graph.

facts.economic_mechanism: The issuer expects 2026 investment to rise significantly year over year, centered on M15X ramp-up, Yongin infrastructure preparation, and EUV equipment; this is a qualitative memory-wide investment plan without a numeric amount, HBM-only capacity, customer allocation, or contract commitment.
facts.exact_quote: 이에 올해 투자 규모는 M15X 램프업, 용인 클러스터를 중심으로 한 인프라 준비와 EUV 등 핵심 장비 확보로 전년 대비 크게 증가할 것이라고 설명했다.
facts.materiality_rationale: This is an issuer-owned, period-specific capacity-investment plan; its qualitative wording prevents a numeric FORWARD_GUIDANCE tag or HBM-only attribution.
facts.normalized_object: FY2026 memory capacity and equipment investment plan
facts.predicate: expects annual investment to increase significantly
facts.subject: SK하이닉스 M15X·용인 클러스터·EUV 투자
facts.value: significant year-over-year investment increase centered on M15X, Yongin, and EUV

facts.economic_mechanism: The issuer plans strategic production-base expansion for mid-to-long-term demand while conditioning investment on demand visibility to balance supply stability and financial soundness; this is an investment policy, not completed capacity, HBM-only allocation, or binding customer demand.
facts.exact_quote: SK하이닉스는 “중장기 수요 성장에 선제적으로 대응할 수 있는 생산 기반을 전략적으로 확충하겠다”며, “수요 가시성을 고려한 투자를 통해 공급 안정성과 재무 건전성을 함께 확보하겠다”고 말했다.
facts.materiality_rationale: This is a distinct forward capacity-discipline statement that explicitly links investment to demand visibility while preserving its nonbinding and memory-wide status.
facts.subject: SK하이닉스 메모리 생산기반 투자
facts.value: expand production base while considering demand visibility and financial soundness

facts.economic_mechanism: The issuer states that the Q1 2026 results release was prepared before completion of the external auditor's accounting review and may change during review, limiting certainty without implying that a reported figure is false.
facts.exact_quote: ※ 同 실적 발표자료는 외부 감사인의 회계검토가 완료되지 않은 상태에서 작성되었으며, 회계 검토 과정에서 달라질 수 있습니다.
facts.materiality_rationale: This period-specific explicit caveat is distinct from the previously accepted FY2025-release uncertainty.

facts.subject: SK하이닉스 2026년 1분기 실적 발표자료

facts.economic_mechanism: The issuer discloses that the presentation information did not undergo separate independent verification and provides no representation or warranty regarding fairness, accuracy, or completeness, creating an explicit information-confidence limitation.
facts.exact_quote: 본 자료는 정보 제공만을 위하여, 당사에 의해 작성된 것으로서, 본 자료에 기재된 정보에 대해서는 별도의 독립적인 확인 과정을 거치지 않았습니다. 본 자료에 포함된 정보의 공정성, 정확성 또는 완결성과 관련해서는 어떠한 진술 및 보장도 제공되지 않으며, 이를 신뢰하여서도 안 됩니다.
facts.materiality_rationale: The source explicitly limits independent verification and information assurance; this is not inferred from silence.

facts.economic_mechanism: The issuer warns that forecasts, plans, expectations, and other forward-looking information are inherently uncertain and may differ materially from actual future performance, explicitly limiting reliance on the capacity and demand plans.
facts.exact_quote: 또한, 본 자료는 미래에 대한 예상, 전망, 계획, 기대 등의 ‘예측정보’를 포함하고 있으며 이러한 ‘예측정보’는 그 성격의 불확실성으로 인해 회사의 실제 미래실적과 중대한 차이가 있을 수 있음을 양지하시기 바랍니다.
facts.materiality_rationale: This explicit forward-looking caveat directly counters certainty assigned to the issuer's investment, demand, pricing, and capacity plans.
